description: Header file defining the c10d namespace components for distributed work management, including the Work class, OpType enum, and related functions for asynchronous collective operations in PyTorch.

classes.name: Work
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous distributed operation in PyTorch, providing methods to check completion, success, retrieve results, synchronize, wait, abort, and manage futures.

classes.name: WorkInfo
classes.description: Stores metadata about a Work operation, including operation type, sequence number, start and finish times, and active duration.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Work object with specified rank, operation type, profiling title, and input tensors.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the work has completed without blocking.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the work completed successfully.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Returns the exception if the work did not succeed.

methods.name: sourceRank
methods.description: Returns the source rank for recv-from-any operations.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Ensures correct sequencing of output tensor operations after completion.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the work completes or timeout occurs.

methods.name: blockCurrentStream
methods.description: Blocks the current stream until the work is complete.

methods.name: getFuture
methods.description: Returns a Future object associated with the work's completion.

methods.name: getFutureResult
methods.description: Returns a Future marked as success or failure for tracking.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the work.

methods.name: getSequencenumber
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the work.

methods.name: retrieveOpType
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the work.

methods.name: create_from_future
methods.description: Creates a Work object from a Future.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the work, optionally setting an exception.

methods.name: finishAndThrow
methods.description: Completes the work and throws if an exception is set.
